answer: According to NIST AI RMF 1.0, privacy-enhancing techniques (PETs) can result in a loss of accuracy under certain conditions, such as data sparsity. This loss in accuracy can affect decisions about fairness and other values in certain domains. Therefore, there are tradeoffs involved between maintaining privacy and ensuring fairness, as the implementation of privacy measures may compromise the accuracy of AI systems, which in turn can influence fairness outcomes.
